Catalog number : I00039 Uniform title: Sakalāgamasārasaṅgraha Manuscript : IFP manuscript bundle RE22716 Description: RE22716 - This manuscript bundle titled Sakalāgamasārasaṅgrahaḥ, is a comprehensive compilation of different topics from various Āgamas and allied texts. It encompasses nearly 70 to 75 subjects, including the Tripurasundarīkavaca (a protective hymn of Tripurasundarī), Jīrṇoddhāraṇavidhi (restoration rituals), and Pratiṣṭhotsavavidhi (consecration ceremonies) for different deities. Additionally, it includes Śāstā-mantram (mantras of Śāstā), various types of Nyāsam (ritualistic placements), and other significant practices derived from texts like the Raurava, Ajita Bhīmasaṃhitā, Suprabheda, Vīratantra, Kāraṇa, Aṃśumāntantra, Dīpta, Vātula, and even references to Āyurveda.The bundle contains 298 folios in 350 mm x 25 mm size and there are 8-9 lines in each folio. This manuscript is a valuable resource for scholars and practitioners interested in the ritualistic, philosophical, and practical aspects of Śaivāgama traditions. It covers many topics from multiple Āgamas which makes this bundle a treasure trove of knowledge for understanding the diversity and depth of Śaiva practices.
